picture.alt: A birthday party in a karaoke room: four young people sit side by side on a long red sofa in front of a big TV screen full of bright round shapes. From the left: a girl with round glasses, wavy brown shoulder-length hair, a white short-sleeved shirt under a dark purple vest and olive-green trousers sings into a black microphone, her other hand on her chest; a young man with black hair, an open light-green shirt over a red striped T-shirt and black trousers claps and smiles at her; a young woman with long wavy dark hair, gold hoop earrings, a blue shirt over an orange top and white trousers holds her hands together under her chin and smiles at the singer; on the right, a young man with short spiky black hair, a blue jacket over a white T-shirt and brown trousers holds a big bunch of red roses wrapped in pink paper and smiles at her. In front of them stand a big white cream cake topped with strawberries, blueberries and five lit candles, three glasses of orange juice with blue straws, and wrapped presents at the edges. Nobody is dancing.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天去KTV幫朋友慶祝生日，東西都準備好了嗎？
lines.simplified: 明天去KTV帮朋友庆祝生日，东西都准备好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān qù KTV bāng péngyǒu qìngzhù shēngrì, dōngxi dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
lines.english: We're celebrating our friend's birthday at the KTV tomorrow. Is everything ready?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 蛋糕已經買好了。可是花店說，玫瑰花要明天中午才準備得好。
lines.simplified: 蛋糕已经买好了。可是花店说，玫瑰花要明天中午才准备得好。
lines.pinyin: Dàngāo yǐjīng mǎi hǎo le. Kěshì huādiàn shuō, méiguī huā yào míngtiān zhōngwǔ cái zhǔnbèi de hǎo.
lines.english: The cake's already bought. But the flower shop says the roses won't be ready until tomorrow noon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那啤酒呢？要不要我現在去買幾罐？
lines.simplified: 那啤酒呢？要不要我现在去买几罐？
lines.pinyin: Nà píjiǔ ne? Yào bú yào wǒ xiànzài qù mǎi jǐ guàn?
lines.english: And the beer? Shall I go and buy a few cans now?

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 什麼東西已經準備好了？
prompt.simplified: 什么东西已经准备好了？
prompt.pinyin: Shénme dōngxi yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le?
prompt.english: What is already ready?

questions.why: 蛋糕已經買好了: the cake is bought and ready. The roses won't be ready until tomorrow noon (才準備得好), and the beer is only something he offers to go and buy.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天要給老師的功課，妳寫好了沒有？
lines.simplified: 明天要给老师的功课，你写好了没有？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān yào gěi lǎoshī de gōngkè, nǐ xiě hǎo le méiyǒu?
lines.english: The homework we have to give the teacher tomorrow: have you finished it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 寫好了，可是我覺得寫得不好，今天晚上想再寫一次。
lines.simplified: 写好了，可是我觉得写得不好，今天晚上想再写一次。
lines.pinyin: Xiě hǎo le, kěshì wǒ juéde xiě de bù hǎo, jīntiān wǎnshàng xiǎng zài xiě yí cì.
lines.english: It's done, but I don't think I wrote it well. I want to write it again tonight.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā de gōngkè hái méi xiě wán.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā duì gōngkè bú tài mǎnyì.
choices.english: She isn't very happy with her homework.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jīntiān wǎnshàng bù xiǎng xiě le.
choices.english: She doesn't want to write any more tonight.

questions.why: 寫好了 says it is finished, but 寫得不好 says she thinks it isn't good, so she isn't happy with it and wants to write it again tonight.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你怎麼現在才到？是不是記錯時間了？
lines.simplified: 你怎么现在才到？是不是记错时间了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái dào? Shì bú shì jì cuò shíjiān le?
lines.english: Why are you only getting here now? Did you get the time wrong?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 時間沒記錯，是我走錯房間了。隔壁的人還請我跟他們一起唱歌呢！
lines.simplified: 时间没记错，是我走错房间了。隔壁的人还请我跟他们一起唱歌呢！
lines.pinyin: Shíjiān méi jì cuò, shì wǒ zǒu cuò fángjiān le. Gébì de rén hái qǐng wǒ gēn tāmen yìqǐ chànggē ne!
lines.english: I didn't get the time wrong; I walked into the wrong room. The people next door even asked me to sing with them!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼現在才到？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么现在才到？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme xiànzài cái dào?
prompt.english: Why is the man only arriving now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ shíjiān jì cuò le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zài lùshàng zǒu cuò le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiān jìn le biéde fángjiān.
choices.english: He went into another room first.

questions.why: 是我走錯房間了: he went into the wrong room, the one next door (隔壁). He says 時間沒記錯, and his 走錯 is about the room, not the way there.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 喂，你在哪裡？我們都到KTV了，就等你一個人。
lines.simplified: 喂，你在哪里？我们都到KTV了，就等你一个人。
lines.pinyin: Wéi, nǐ zài nǎlǐ? Wǒmen dōu dào KTV le, jiù děng nǐ yígerén.
lines.english: Hello, where are you? We're all at the KTV; we're only waiting for you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 什麼？我記得是明天晚上啊！
lines.simplified: 什么？我记得是明天晚上啊！
lines.pinyin: Shénme? Wǒ jìde shì míngtiān wǎnshàng a!
lines.english: What? I remember it being tomorrow night!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你記錯了，是今天晚上！你趕快過來吧。
lines.simplified: 你记错了，是今天晚上！你赶快过来吧。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jì cuò le, shì jīntiān wǎnshàng! Nǐ gǎnkuài guòlái ba.
lines.english: You've got it wrong, it's tonight! Hurry over.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的現在最可能做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的现在最可能做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài zuì kěnéng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will the man most likely do now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā míngtiān wǎnshàng zài qù KTV.
choices.english: He'll go to the KTV tomorrow night.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: He'll wait at the KTV for his friends.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He'll leave for the KTV right away.

questions.why: 你記錯了: he remembered the wrong day. The party is tonight and everyone is already waiting for him, so he will hurry over now. Tomorrow night was his mistake, and it is his friends who are waiting at the KTV.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想學游泳，可是我已經三十歲了，現在學還學得會嗎？
lines.simplified: 我想学游泳，可是我已经三十岁了，现在学还学得会吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng xué yóuyǒng, kěshì wǒ yǐjīng sānshí suì le, xiànzài xué hái xué de huì ma?
lines.english: I want to learn to swim, but I'm already thirty. Can I still learn it now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 當然學得會！我爸爸五十歲才開始學，學了兩個月就學會了。
lines.simplified: 当然学得会！我爸爸五十岁才开始学，学了两个月就学会了。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán xué de huì! Wǒ bàba wǔshí suì cái kāishǐ xué, xué le liǎng ge yuè jiù xuéhuì le.
lines.english: Of course you can! My dad only started at fifty, and he could swim after two months.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說她爸爸怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的说她爸爸怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō tā bàba zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman say about her father?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā sānshí suì jiù xuéhuì le.
choices.english: He had learned to swim by thirty.

choices.english: He didn't take up swimming until fifty.

choices.pinyin: Tā xué le liǎng nián cái xuéhuì.
choices.english: It took him two years to learn.

questions.why: 我爸爸五十歲才開始學，學了兩個月就學會了: her father only started at fifty and learned it (學會了) in two months, not two years. Thirty is the man's own age.

focus.zh: 五十歲才開始學／學會了
focus.en: only started at fifty / learned it

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你可以教我這首日文歌嗎？下星期六我想跟朋友合唱。
lines.simplified: 你可以教我这首日文歌吗？下星期六我想跟朋友合唱。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ zhè shǒu Rìwén gē ma? Xià xīngqíliù wǒ xiǎng gēn péngyǒu héchàng.
lines.english: Can you teach me this Japanese song? Next Saturday I want to sing it with a friend.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啊！可是這首歌有一點難，我教了我妹妹好幾次，她還是沒學會。
lines.simplified: 好啊！可是这首歌有一点难，我教了我妹妹好几次，她还是没学会。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a! Kěshì zhè shǒu gē yǒu yìdiǎn nán, wǒ jiāo le wǒ mèimei hǎojǐ cì, tā háishì méi xuéhuì.
lines.english: Sure! But this song is a bit hard. I've taught my little sister several times and she still hasn't learned it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒關係，我每天練習，一定學得會。
lines.simplified: 没关系，我每天练习，一定学得会。
lines.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒ měitiān liànxí, yídìng xué de huì.
lines.english: That's OK. I'll practice every day; I'm sure I can learn it.

prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng jiāo huì mèimei le.
choices.english: He has already taught his sister the song.

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: This song isn't easy to learn.

choices.simplified: 他想跟女的合唱这首歌。
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng gēn nǚ de héchàng zhè shǒu gē.
choices.english: He wants to sing this song with the woman.

questions.why: 這首歌有一點難…她還是沒學會: the song is a bit hard; after several lessons his sister still can't sing it, so he has not 教會 her. It is the woman who wants to sing it with a friend.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個星期六我們去KTV唱歌，好不好？
lines.simplified: 这个星期六我们去KTV唱歌，好不好？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù wǒmen qù KTV chànggē, hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Shall we go and sing at the KTV this Saturday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 週末常常客滿，也比平日貴多了。我星期三、星期五下午都沒課，妳哪天方便，我們就哪天去。
lines.simplified: 周末常常客满，也比平日贵多了。我星期三、星期五下午都没课，你哪天方便，我们就哪天去。
lines.pinyin: Zhōumò chángcháng kèmǎn, yě bǐ píngrì guì duō le. Wǒ xīngqísān, xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ dōu méi kè, nǐ nǎ tiān fāngbiàn, wǒmen jiù nǎ tiān qù.
lines.english: Weekends are often fully booked, and much more expensive than weekdays. I have no class on Wednesday or Friday afternoon. Whichever day suits you, we'll go then.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 星期五下午我得去圖書館，晚上才有空。
lines.simplified: 星期五下午我得去图书馆，晚上才有空。
lines.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ wǒ děi qù túshūguǎn, wǎnshàng cái yǒu kòng.
lines.english: Friday afternoon I have to go to the library; I'm only free in the evening.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 晚上也比較貴。星期三下午呢？
lines.simplified: 晚上也比较贵。星期三下午呢？
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshàng yě bǐjiào guì. Xīngqísān xiàwǔ ne?
lines.english: Evenings cost more too. What about Wednesday afternoon?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒問題，那就星期三吧！
lines.simplified: 没问题，那就星期三吧！
lines.pinyin: Méi wèntí, nà jiù xīngqísān ba!
lines.english: No problem. Wednesday it is, then!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定什麼時候去KTV？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定什么时候去KTV？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng shénme shíhòu qù KTV?
prompt.english: When did they decide to go to the KTV in the end?

questions.why: 妳哪天方便，我們就哪天去: he lets her pick one of his free afternoons. Friday afternoon she has the library and Friday evening costs more, so they settle on Wednesday afternoon. Saturday was only her first idea.

focus.en: whichever day suits, go that day

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 今天一共三千塊，我們五個人，一個人付六百吧。
lines.simplified: 今天一共三千块，我们五个人，一个人付六百吧。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān yígòng sānqiān kuài, wǒmen wǔ ge rén, yí ge rén fù liùbǎi ba.
lines.english: Today's three thousand in all. There are five of us, so six hundred each.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那怎麼可以！我才點了兩首歌，你一個人點了二十首。
lines.simplified: 那怎么可以！我才点了两首歌，你一个人点了二十首。
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme kěyǐ! Wǒ cái diǎn le liǎng shǒu gē, nǐ yígerén diǎn le èrshí shǒu.
lines.english: That's not fair! I only picked two songs, and you picked twenty on your own.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳說怎麼付？
lines.simplified: 那你说怎么付？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ shuō zěnme fù?
lines.english: Then how should we pay, in your view?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 誰點的歌多，誰就多付一點。
lines.simplified: 谁点的歌多，谁就多付一点。
lines.pinyin: Shéi diǎn de gē duō, shéi jiù duō fù yìdiǎn.
lines.english: Whoever picked more songs pays a bit more.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，那我付一千，剩下的你們四個人一起付。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那我付一千，剩下的你们四个人一起付。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà wǒ fù yìqiān, shèngxià de nǐmen sì ge rén yìqǐ fù.
lines.english: All right, then I'll pay a thousand, and the four of you pay the rest together.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 男的最后要付多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu yào fù duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: How much will the man pay in the end?

questions.why: 誰點的歌多，誰就多付一點: whoever picked more songs pays more. He picked twenty, so he pays 一千. Six hundred was his first even split, three thousand is the whole bill, and the other four pay five hundred each.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下星期是我室友的生日，我想送她香水或是巧克力，可是不知道她比較喜歡哪一個。
lines.simplified: 下星期是我室友的生日，我想送她香水或是巧克力，可是不知道她比较喜欢哪一个。
lines.pinyin: Xià xīngqí shì wǒ shìyǒu de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā xiāngshuǐ huòshì qiǎokèlì, kěshì bù zhīdào tā bǐjiào xǐhuān nǎ yí ge.
lines.english: Next week is my roommate's birthday. I want to give her perfume or chocolate, but I don't know which she'd like more.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她很愛吃甜的嗎？
lines.simplified: 她很爱吃甜的吗？
lines.pinyin: Tā hěn ài chī tián de ma?
lines.english: Does she love sweet things?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不太愛。可是香水她已經有好幾瓶了，我怕她覺得太多了。
lines.simplified: 不太爱。可是香水她已经有好几瓶了，我怕她觉得太多了。
lines.pinyin: Bú tài ài. Kěshì xiāngshuǐ tā yǐjīng yǒu hǎojǐ píng le, wǒ pà tā juéde tài duō le.

lines.pinyin: Tā měitiān dōu yòng xiāngshuǐ, duō yì píng yě yòng de dào. Sòng xiāngshuǐ ba, tā huì xǐhuān de.
lines.english: She wears perfume every day, so one more bottle will get used. Give her perfume; she'll like it.

prompt.simplified: 男的觉得室友会怎么样？

prompt.english: What does the man think the roommate will feel?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shōu dào xiāngshuǐ huì hěn gāoxìng.
choices.english: She'll be happy to get perfume.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huì juéde xiāngshuǐ tài duō le.
choices.english: She'll think she has too much perfume.

choices.pinyin: Huì měitiān dōu chī tián de.

answer.traditional: 桌上除了吃的東西，還有一個好玩的樂器。

answer.pinyin: Zhuō shàng chúle chī de dōngxi, hái yǒu yí ge hǎowán de yuèqì.
answer.english: Besides the food, there's a fun musical instrument on the table.

questions.why: The red tambourine on the table is a 樂器 (musical instrument) to play while singing. A 機器 is a machine, and the 地板 (floor) is not on the table.

prompt.traditional: 沙發上穿綠色衣服的男生看起來很＿＿。

answer.pinyin: Shāfā shàng chuān lǜsè yīfu de nánshēng kànqǐlái hěn xīngfèn.
answer.english: The young man in green on the sofa looks very excited.

questions.why: He laughs with one fist in the air, so he looks 興奮 (excited), not 害羞 (shy) or 傷心 (sad).

prompt.traditional: 這首歌＿＿沙發上的兩個人都好開心。
prompt.simplified: 这首歌＿＿沙发上的两个人都好开心。

answer.traditional: 這首歌讓沙發上的兩個人都好開心。

answer.english: This song makes the two on the sofa really happy.

questions.why: A 讓 B + feeling: the song (A) makes the two on the sofa (B) happy. 被 marks the passive and 把 an object; neither links a cause to a feeling.

On the orange sofa, a young woman with long wavy black hair, gold hoop earrings, an orange top and white trousers laughs with her eyes closed and claps; next to her, a young man with curly brown hair, an olive-green hoodie and dark trousers laughs and raises one fist in the air. On the dark round table in front lie a red tambourine, a bowl of French fries, a plate of fried chicken pieces with lettuce and a small dish of red sauce, and a glass of cola with ice and a straw.

prompt.traditional: 桌上有一＿＿冰的飲料。
prompt.simplified: 桌上有一＿＿冰的饮料。

answer.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu yì bēi bīng de yǐnliào.

questions.why: A drink in a glass is counted with 杯. 束 is for bunches of flowers and 首 for songs.

prompt.traditional: 沙發上的女生聽得很開心，一直在＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 沙发上的女生听得很开心，一直在＿＿。

answer.pinyin: Shāfā shàng de nǚshēng tīng de hěn kāixīn, yìzhí zài xiào.
answer.english: The young woman on the sofa is enjoying it and keeps laughing.

questions.why: She claps and laughs with her eyes closed: 一直在笑. She isn't crying (哭), and she is sitting, not dancing (跳).

prompt.traditional: 跟朋友一起在KTV吃東西、聽歌，真＿＿人覺得輕鬆。
prompt.simplified: 跟朋友一起在KTV吃东西、听歌，真＿＿人觉得轻松。

answer.traditional: 跟朋友一起在KTV吃東西、聽歌，真讓人覺得輕鬆。
answer.simplified: 跟朋友一起在KTV吃东西、听歌，真让人觉得轻松。
answer.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ zài KTV chī dōngxi, tīng gē, zhēn ràng rén juéde qīngsōng.
answer.english: Eating and listening to songs with friends at the KTV really makes you feel relaxed.

questions.why: A 讓 B + feeling: an evening at the KTV with friends makes people (人) feel relaxed. 替 means 'on behalf of' and 被 marks the passive; neither links a cause to a feeling.

passage.traditional: 上個週末，我第一次帶爸爸媽媽去KTV。那裡的{1}很多，有新歌，也有很多老歌。我們點了好幾首，一家人一起{2}，非常熱鬧。爸爸一開始有點害羞，後來點的歌比誰都多。KTV的機器還會給唱歌的人{3}，爸爸的分數最{4}，才六十分，可是他說開心最重要。媽媽說下次還要再來。
passage.simplified: 上个周末，我第一次带爸爸妈妈去KTV。那里的{1}很多，有新歌，也有很多老歌。我们点了好几首，一家人一起{2}，非常热闹。爸爸一开始有点害羞，后来点的歌比谁都多。KTV的机器还会给唱歌的人{3}，爸爸的分数最{4}，才六十分，可是他说开心最重要。妈妈说下次还要再来。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge zhōumò, wǒ dì yī cì dài bàba māma qù KTV. Nàlǐ de gēqǔ hěn duō, yǒu xīn gē, yě yǒu hěn duō lǎo gē. Wǒmen diǎn le hǎojǐ shǒu, yìjiārén yìqǐ héchàng, fēicháng rènao. Bàba yì kāishǐ yǒudiǎn hàixiū, hòulái diǎn de gē bǐ shéi dōu duō. KTV de jīqì hái huì gěi chànggē de rén dǎfēnshù, bàba de fēnshù zuì dī, cái liùshí fēn, kěshì tā shuō kāixīn zuì zhòngyào. Māma shuō xià cì hái yào zài lái.
passage.english: Last weekend I took my mom and dad to KTV for the first time. There were lots of songs, new ones and lots of old ones too. We picked several, and the whole family sang together; it was really lively. Dad was a bit shy at first, but in the end he picked more songs than anyone. The KTV machine even gives the singers a score. Dad got the lowest, only sixty, but he said having fun is what matters most. Mom said she wants to come again next time.

questions.why: 那裡的歌曲很多: the KTV has lots of songs, new and old.
一家人一起合唱: the whole family sings together, which is lively.
給唱歌的人打分數: the machine gives each singer a score.
分數最低，才六十分: only sixty, the lowest score of the family.

passage.traditional: 學校後面有一家{1}的餐廳。那裡的台灣小吃，從滷肉飯到豆花，{2}的都有，客人想吃什麼就拿什麼，{3}擔心吃不飽。不過週末人很多，常常要排隊，所以我都{4}平日中午沒課的時間去，人少，也比較便宜。我最喜歡那裡的鹹酥雞跟芒果冰，每次都吃得很飽。
passage.simplified: 学校后面有一家{1}的餐厅。那里的台湾小吃，从卤肉饭到豆花，{2}的都有，客人想吃什么就拿什么，{3}担心吃不饱。不过周末人很多，常常要排队，所以我都{4}平日中午没课的时间去，人少，也比较便宜。我最喜欢那里的咸酥鸡跟芒果冰，每次都吃得很饱。
passage.pinyin: Xuéxiào hòumiàn yǒu yì jiā chīdàobǎo de cāntīng. Nàlǐ de Táiwān xiǎochī, cóng lǔròufàn dào dòuhuā, gèshìgèyàng de dōu yǒu, kèrén xiǎng chī shénme jiù ná shénme, búbì dānxīn chī bù bǎo. Búguò zhōumò rén hěn duō, chángcháng yào páiduì, suǒyǐ wǒ dōu lìyòng píngrì zhōngwǔ méi kè de shíjiān qù, rén shǎo, yě bǐjiào piányí. Wǒ zuì xǐhuān nàlǐ de xiánsūjī gēn mángguǒbīng, měi cì dōu chī de hěn bǎo.
passage.english: Behind school there is an all-you-can-eat restaurant. It has every kind of Taiwanese snack, from braised pork rice to tofu pudding, and guests take whatever they want, so there's no need to worry about going hungry. But on weekends it's crowded and you often have to queue, so I use my free weekday lunchtimes to go: fewer people, and cheaper too. I like their popcorn chicken and mango ice best, and I always leave full.

questions.why: 一家吃到飽的餐廳: an all-you-can-eat restaurant, so guests take whatever they like.
從滷肉飯到豆花，各式各樣的都有: every kind of snack is there.
不必擔心吃不飽: with everything on offer, there's no need to worry about going hungry.
利用……沒課的時間: make use of the weekday lunchtimes when there's no class.

text.traditional: 我來台灣半年了。第一次跟台灣同學去KTV的時候，我不會中文歌，只能坐在旁邊聽大家唱歌。後來，一個同學每個星期教我兩首歌，現在我已經學會十幾首了。下個月班上要辦活動，我打算表演一首中文歌，希望大家會喜歡。
text.simplified: 我来台湾半年了。第一次跟台湾同学去KTV的时候，我不会中文歌，只能坐在旁边听大家唱歌。后来，一个同学每个星期教我两首歌，现在我已经学会十几首了。下个月班上要办活动，我打算表演一首中文歌，希望大家会喜欢。
text.pinyin: Wǒ lái Táiwān bàn nián le. Dì yī cì gēn Táiwān tóngxué qù KTV de shíhòu, wǒ bú huì Zhōngwén gē, zhǐ néng zuò zài pángbiān tīng dàjiā chànggē. Hòulái, yí ge tóngxué měi ge xīngqí jiāo wǒ liǎng shǒu gē, xiànzài wǒ yǐjīng xuéhuì shí jǐ shǒu le. Xià ge yuè bān shàng yào bàn huódòng, wǒ dǎsuàn biǎoyǎn yì shǒu Zhōngwén gē, xīwàng dàjiā huì xǐhuān.
text.english: I've been in Taiwan for half a year. The first time I went to KTV with Taiwanese classmates, I didn't know any Chinese songs and could only sit at the side listening to everyone sing. Then a classmate started teaching me two songs a week, and now I've learned over ten. Next month our class is holding an event, and I plan to perform a Chinese song. I hope everyone will like it.

prompt.simplified: 这个人现在怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège rén xiànzài zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How is this person doing now?

text.traditional: 今天是我男朋友的生日。我本來想請他去吃牛排，可是他說想去KTV唱歌。到了KTV，我們才發現因為是假日，房間都客滿了。最後我們去便利商店買了一個小蛋糕，坐在學校旁邊的公園裡，一邊吃一邊聊天。他說，這是他最開心的一個生日。
text.simplified: 今天是我男朋友的生日。我本来想请他去吃牛排，可是他说想去KTV唱歌。到了KTV，我们才发现因为是假日，房间都客满了。最后我们去便利商店买了一个小蛋糕，坐在学校旁边的公园里，一边吃一边聊天。他说，这是他最开心的一个生日。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ nánpéngyǒu de shēngrì. Wǒ běnlái xiǎng qǐng tā qù chī niúpái, kěshì tā shuō xiǎng qù KTV chànggē. Dào le KTV, wǒmen cái fāxiàn yīnwèi shì jiàrì, fángjiān dōu kèmǎn le. Zuìhòu wǒmen qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi le yí ge xiǎo dàngāo, zuò zài xuéxiào pángbiān de gōngyuán lǐ, yìbiān chī yìbiān liáotiān. Tā shuō, zhè shì tā zuì kāixīn de yí ge shēngrì.
text.english: Today is my boyfriend's birthday. I first wanted to take him out for steak, but he said he wanted to go and sing at a KTV. When we got there, we found every room was fully booked because it was a holiday. In the end we bought a small cake at a convenience store and sat in the park next to school, eating and chatting. He said it was his happiest birthday ever.

prompt.traditional: 他們最後在哪裡慶祝生日？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后在哪里庆祝生日？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu zài nǎlǐ qìngzhù shēngrì?
prompt.english: Where did they celebrate the birthday in the end?

questions.why: The steak was only her first plan (本來), the KTV was fully booked (客滿), and the convenience store is just where they bought the cake. They ate it in the park next to school.

text.traditional: 我妹妹這次考試考得不好，回家以後一直在房間裡哭。我想帶她去KTV輕鬆一下，可是她說不想出門。後來我告訴她，那家KTV可以吃到飽，她才跟我去。她在那裡吃了很多東西，也點了很多歌。回家的路上，她說吃東西、唱歌讓她心情好多了。
text.simplified: 我妹妹这次考试考得不好，回家以后一直在房间里哭。我想带她去KTV轻松一下，可是她说不想出门。后来我告诉她，那家KTV可以吃到饱，她才跟我去。她在那里吃了很多东西，也点了很多歌。回家的路上，她说吃东西、唱歌让她心情好多了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei zhè cì kǎoshì kǎo de bù hǎo, huí jiā yǐhòu yìzhí zài fángjiān lǐ kū. Wǒ xiǎng dài tā qù KTV qīngsōng yíxià, kěshì tā shuō bù xiǎng chūmén. Hòulái wǒ gàosu tā, nà jiā KTV kěyǐ chīdàobǎo, tā cái gēn wǒ qù. Tā zài nàlǐ chī le hěn duō dōngxi, yě diǎn le hěn duō gē. Huí jiā de lùshàng, tā shuō chī dōngxi, chànggē ràng tā xīnqíng hǎo duō le.
text.english: My little sister did badly in this exam and cried in her room the whole time after she got home. I wanted to take her to KTV to relax, but she said she didn't want to go out. Then I told her that KTV was all-you-can-eat, and only then did she come with me. She ate lots there and picked lots of songs. On the way home she said the food and the singing had made her feel much better.

text.traditional: 我的室友很不愛打掃，房間總是又髒又亂。我叫他打掃，他總是說等一下。上個週末他要搬家，房東說要先把房間打掃乾淨，才能拿回押金。他就把髒衣服都洗了，把地掃乾淨，還把桌子擦了一次。原來他也會打掃！

text.english: My roommate really doesn't like cleaning, and his room is always dirty and messy. When I tell him to clean, he always says 'in a minute'. Last weekend he was moving out, and the landlord said the room had to be cleaned first before he could get his deposit back. So he washed all his dirty clothes, swept the floor clean and even wiped the table. So he can clean after all!

prompt.english: Why did the roommate clean his room last weekend?

choices.pinyin: Tā měi ge zhōumò dōu dǎsǎo.

choices.english: The landlord told him to move out.

choices.pinyin: Tā juéde fángjiān tài zāng le.
choices.english: He thought his room was too dirty.

questions.why: 要先把房間打掃乾淨，才能拿回押金: only a clean room gets the deposit back (……，才……), so that is why he cleaned. The mess never bothers him, he doesn't clean every weekend, and the move was his own; the landlord only asked for a clean room.

text.traditional: 我家附近有一家很特別的書店。只要買兩本書，就送一杯咖啡。每個星期六晚上，書店都會辦活動，有時候請寫書的人來介紹新書，有時候放電影給大家看。書店裡的椅子很舒服，我常常看書看著看著，就忘了時間。
text.simplified: 我家附近有一家很特别的书店。只要买两本书，就送一杯咖啡。每个星期六晚上，书店都会办活动，有时候请写书的人来介绍新书，有时候放电影给大家看。书店里的椅子很舒服，我常常看书看着看着，就忘了时间。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yì jiā hěn tèbié de shūdiàn. Zhǐyào mǎi liǎng běn shū, jiù sòng yì bēi kāfēi. Měi ge xīngqíliù wǎnshàng, shūdiàn dōu huì bàn huódòng, yǒushíhòu qǐng xiě shū de rén lái jièshào xīn shū, yǒushíhòu fàng diànyǐng gěi dàjiā kàn. Shūdiàn lǐ de yǐzi hěn shūfu, wǒ chángcháng kàn shū kànzhe kànzhe, jiù wàng le shíjiān.
text.english: Near my home there is a very special bookstore. Buy two books and you get a free coffee. Every Saturday evening the store holds an event: sometimes a writer comes to present a new book, sometimes they show a film for everyone. The chairs in the store are so comfortable that I often lose track of time reading.

prompt.traditional: 在這家書店，怎麼樣可以拿到一杯咖啡？
prompt.simplified: 在这家书店，怎么样可以拿到一杯咖啡？
prompt.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā shūdiàn, zěnmeyàng kěyǐ ná dào yì bēi kāfēi?
prompt.english: At this bookstore, how do you get a cup of coffee?

choices.english: Come to a film on Saturday evening.

questions.why: 只要買兩本書，就送一杯咖啡: the condition is buying two books. One book isn't enough, reading in the store doesn't count, and the Saturday films are only 有時候 (sometimes) and come with no coffee.
